A small field guide to four familiar European gulls. Start with the whole bird, then compare a few useful details.

- **Herring Gull** — pale grey back, with white markings in the black wing tips.
- **Black-headed Gull** — a chocolate-brown hood in breeding plumage.
- **Kittiwake** — black wing tips that look dipped in ink.
- **Great Black-backed Gull** — dark back, strong bill and pink legs.

Keep the species guides in **Resources** nearby while you explore.

Source: [RSPB gull identification](https://www.rspb.org.uk/birds-and-wildlife/identifying-birds/uk-gull-identification).
